name: Sylvia Tamale
shortBio: Ugandan feminist legal philosopher and sociologist who theorized Afro-feminist jurisprudence, Ubuntu relationality, and the decolonization of African law and sexualities.
centralQuestion: How can African jurisprudence shed Victorian colonial moralism by centering Ubuntu ethics and Afro-feminist pluralism?

keyWorks.title: Decolonization and Afro-Feminism
keyWorks.description: Integrates Ubuntu philosophy, decolonial legal theory, and African feminist praxis to reimagine justice beyond Eurocentric law.

keyWorks.title: African Sexualities: A Reader
keyWorks.description: Foundational edited volume reclaiming African epistemologies of gender, desire, and bodily sovereignty.
